descriptionChirho: The ancient city of Sodom in the Jordan plain, destroyed by divine judgment (Genesis 19), frequently invoked as a paradigm of wickedness and catastrophic punishment throughout prophetic and wisdom literature. All four clusters represent the same toponym with different prepositions: bare nominative/genitive, with ke- (like Sodom), with be- (in Sodom), and directional (to/toward Sodom). Multilingual glosses are uniform: Arabic Saduma, Spanish Sodoma/Sedom, Hindi Sadom/Sedom, Korean Sodom, Swahili Sodoma. Purely grammatical variants of one place name.
